verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists "Built-in Sales Flows and Lead Routing", and Agent Builder docs refer to existing Salesforce Flows as automation assets, so a workflow engine exists. A hands-on community comment reports setting up a timed email automation in minutes, which supports the notification part. The pack never documents trigger conditions, automatic record updates, or task creation, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of trigger-based flow configuration, evidence of automated record updates and task creation, and in-depth first-party automation docs.
